role: Extension of FitnessRecordingView with the metric tile grid, α1 physiology card, map card, derived label formatters, hold-to-end stop button and voice bar; plus the private StableMapCard map view.
types: FitnessRecordingView: extension — tiles, physiology, controls; static α1 bar geometry alpha1BarMax (1.5) and the Hard/Threshold and Threshold/Easy cuts from HRVConstants.DFA
StableMapCard: struct (private) — single persistent Map over the live track with overlay states and throttled camera framing
toplevel: Static α1 bar constants derived from HRVConstants.DFA.alpha1AnaerobicThreshold/alpha1AerobicThreshold.

units.does: 2-column LazyVGrid holding the elapsed tile, distance/pace tiles, avg-HR/steps/elevation tiles, conditional power/METs tiles and live trend (HR drift, decoupling) tiles.
units.entry: Rendered from FitnessRecordingView.heavySubcards once heavySubcardsReady is true

units.does: TimelineView ticking every 0.5 s that renders the Elapsed tile with CoachReportGenerator.formatDuration(elapsedInterval(at: context.date)) (H:MM:SS / M:SS).

Returns live elapsed seconds: while phase is .recording and not paused and a session start exists, now − startDate − sum of completed pause spans (clamped ≥0); otherwise the published pause-aware recorder.elapsedSeconds.

branches.effect: true: wall-clock minus closed pause spans, max(0, …); false (paused/idle/finalizing/no session): TimeInterval(recorder.elapsedSeconds)

units.does: Emits the Distance tile (icon location.fill for GPS sports, figure.walk otherwise; value distanceLabel, no caption) and the Pace tile (currentPaceLabel, caption avgPaceCaption — the one place the average pace shows).
Emits Avg HR tile (avgHRLabel / peakHRCaption), Steps tile (stepCount or '—' when 0, caption cadenceCaption) and Elevation tile (elevationLabel).

branches.effect: true: step count as text; false: '—'

units.does: Emits a Power tile ('<w> W', caption 'foot pod') only when a foot pod is active and reports watts, and a METs tile (1 decimal, caption 'est') only when the latest sample has METs.

branches.effect: true: power tile shown; false: omitted
true: METs tile shown; false: omitted

units.does: Shows an HR Drift tile ('%+.1f%%', caption 'fatiguing' when drift > 5 else 'stable') when WorkoutLiveTrends.hrDriftPercent returns a value, then the decoupling tile.

branches.effect: true: drift tile rendered; false: omitted

units.does: Shows a Decoupling tile ('%+.1f%%', caption 'decoupled' when > 5 else 'coupled') when WorkoutLiveTrends.aerobicDecouplingPercent returns a value.
Builds one metric tile card: header (icon+label), large value, optional caption, card background.

branches.effect: true: caption Text rendered; false: omitted

units.does: Renders the tile value at 48 pt rounded bold, monospaced, single line, shrinking to 50%, numeric content transition.
Renders the tile header row: SF Symbol icon and label text.
Card containing the α1 readout row and the α1 indicator bar.
HStack of alpha1Value and alpha1BandBadge.
Capsule badge with displayedAlpha1Band.localizedLabel ('—', Easy, Threshold, Very Hard).
Shows the 'DFA α1' label, alpha1Label value at 30 pt, and alpha1Caption when non-nil.

branches.effect: true: caption shown (2 lines max); false: omitted

units.does: GeometryReader-driven α1 bar (14 pt) with Hard / Threshold / Easy labels underneath, each centred under its colour band (alpha1BandLabels), the bands cut at the badge's 0.50 / 0.75 thresholds.
HStack of the Hard, Threshold and Easy labels with widths of their bands (0–0.50, 0.50–0.75, 0.75–1.5 of the 1.5 bar) so each sits centred under its band; 9 pt scaled, tertiary colour.
One band label: single line, shrinking to 60%, framed to the band's width (never negative).
Clamps dfa.currentAlpha1 to 0…alpha1BarMax (1.5), maps it to an x offset (value/1.5 × width) and layers the band gradient plus the dot.

Hard-edged band gradient clipped to an 8 pt capsule (0.7 opacity): attention over 0–0.50, caution over 0.50–0.75, then good shading to optimal over the Easy band 0.75–1.5 — the same cuts as LiveDFAAnalyzer.Band.display.
Draws the 14 pt white dot at dotX−7, clamped to the bar's width, with animation and a VoiceOver label 'Current α1 <value>'.

branches.effect: true: dot drawn; false: no dot

units.does: Builds StableMapCard from the recorder's live track array itself (no per-tick coordinate copy) and the location manager's last horizontal accuracy.
Formats recorder.distanceMeters with the current units preference.
reads: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (App Group suite, legacy migration from standard)

units.does: Formats recorder.elevationGainMeters with the current units preference.
reads: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (App Group suite, legacy migration from standard)

units.does: Returns '<n> spm' from recorder.cadenceStepsPerMin, or nil when absent or ≤0.

branches.effect: false: nil (no caption); true: rounded spm string

units.does: Formats the live pace (recorder.currentPaceSecPerKm/1000 s per metre) in the user's units; '—' when there is no pace or the formatter rejects it.
reads: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (App Group suite, legacy migration from standard)

units.does: 'avg <pace>' caption from elapsed/distance, nil until distance > 50 m and elapsed > 10 s.
reads: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (App Group suite, legacy migration from standard)

branches.effect: false: nil; true: formatted pace mapped to 'avg …' (formatPace repeats the same guard)

units.does: Mean of all non-nil sample heart rates, rounded, or '—' when there are none.
'peak <n>' caption, or nil when peakHR is 0.
METs of the last captured sample (nil when there are no samples or no METs).
Current α1 formatted to 2 decimals in the app locale; '—' when nil.
Caption under α1. Non-strap source: 'Connect a chest strap to enable α1'. Otherwise it is chosen by dfa.status: warm-up %, strap silent N s, fit failed, too noisy N %, or the band caption when ok.

branches.effect: true: returns the connect-strap message; false: switch on status
'fit failed — HR too flat for this window'
returns alpha1BandCaption (nil when α1 is nil)

units.does: LiveDFAAnalyzer.Band.display(alpha1:) of the current α1, or .unknown when α1 is nil.
Maps the displayed band to a caption: below/near aerobic threshold, very hard intensity, or nil when unknown.
True when recorder.phase is .finalizing or .finished, false for .recording, .idle, .failed.
The hold-to-end stop button: stopButtonSurface wrapped in the hold gesture.
52 pt GeometryReader surface hosting the stop button layers at full width.

Attaches a zero-distance DragGesture that only updates the @GestureState stopPressActive; onChange of it calls startHolding when a press begins and cancelHolding when it ends — including a cancelled gesture, since SwiftUI resets gesture state on cancellation — and onDisappear cancels any hold. Accessibility comes from withStopAccessibility.

branches.effect: startHolding (which itself answers a press while finalizing with a warning haptic); press ended/cancelled → cancelHolding

units.does: VoiceOver label/hint by finalizing state and an 'End workout now' accessibility action that calls onStop directly unless finalizing.
calls: closure:onStop — set by FitnessTabView.stateBody to FitnessTabView.stopAction(for:) → Task{ await recorder.stop() }

branches.effect: hint 'Saving in progress' vs 'Press and hold…'

units.does: ZStack of track, fill (width × holdProgress) and label, 52 pt, with an accent shadow.
Rounded accent-coloured background, dimmed to 0.45 opacity while finalizing (0.85 otherwise).
Red gradient fill whose width is width × holdProgress, drawn only when not finalizing.
Label row: savingLabel while finalizing, otherwise holdToEndLabel.
Spinner plus 'Saving workout…' text.
Stop icon plus 'Hold to end… <remaining>' countdown (rounded up to tenths, min 0.1 s) while holding, else 'Hold 1.2s to end workout'.

branches.effect: true: countdown text; false: idle text

units.does: Starts a hold. Ignores repeat calls while holding. If finalizing, fires a warning haptic and returns. Otherwise sets isHolding, resets progress, fires a light impact haptic and (re)creates the 50 ms hold timer.

branches.effect: true: warning haptic once per press (the gesture calls this on press start), return; false: begin hold

units.does: Creates a repeating 0.05 s Timer added to RunLoop.main in .common mode. Each tick calls advanceHold(by: 0.05/1.2) on the main actor.
Adds increment to holdProgress (capped at 1). When it reaches 1, invalidates the timer, clears isHolding and calls completeHold.

branches.effect: false: return (keep filling); true: stop timer, completeHold()

units.does: Fires a success haptic, calls onStop() (ends the workout) and resets holdProgress to 0.
Formats seconds as a narrow UnitDuration measurement in the app locale with 0–1 fraction digits ('1.2s').
Ends a hold. Gives a soft haptic if the user let go between 5% and 100%, invalidates the timer, clears isHolding and animates holdProgress back to 0.
HStack of the Talk toggle and the (conditional) close button.
An X button that calls conversation.stop(), shown only while the voice conversation is not idle.
Full-width voice button whose icon, label and colour follow conversation.state. Tapping calls conversation.toggle().
SF Symbol name for each voice state.
Localized button text for each voice state.
Background colour for each voice state.

180 pt map card: a constant backdrop, then the waiting placeholder when the track is empty or the live map otherwise. Overlays the GPS accuracy badge; reframes the camera on appear and whenever the newest fix changes (its timestamp), so a track already present at mount and a replaced seed fix are framed too.
Always-present 180 pt rounded backdrop so the card height never changes.
'Waiting for GPS fix…' placeholder with icon and sky-view hint, combined for VoiceOver.
Maps the track to coordinates once, then a single Map bound to @State position: a polyline once there are ≥2 points and a marker at the latest point (primary tint with ≥2 points, sage with 1).
Shows a 'GPS ±Nm' capsule when horizontal accuracy is worse than 20 m.
When the track is non-empty and shouldReframe says so, records the count and moves the camera: to the region around the whole track with ≥2 points, else a 200 m region on the single point.

branches.cond: empty track or no reframe due

branches.effect: region over the track; else 200 m around the one point

units.does: True for the first framing, a one-point track (each new fix — a seed replaced by a real one), a track that shrank below the last framed count, or one that grew by 10+ points since.
Bounding region for the track via MapBoundsHelper.region(for:).
